hooks.name: Format and lint Python on save
hooks.description: Formats and auto-fixes lint on Python files with ruff when saved, keeping the repo clean for reviewers.

action.command: if command -v ruff >/dev/null 2>&1; then ruff format . && ruff check --fix . 2>&1 | tail -n 20; else echo "ruff not installed — run: pip install ruff"; fi
